1205.name: ADAPt
1205.desc: Convert all of your bonus attack damage into ability power at a rate of 1 ability power per 0.6 bonus attack damage. Additionally, increase your ability power by 15%.

1141.name: All For You
1141.desc: Your heals and shields on allied champions are increased in effectiveness by 30%.

1002.name: Apex Inventor
1002.desc: Grants 100 item haste, which is equivalent to 50% cooldown reduction for items.

2087.name: Archmage
2087.desc: Whenever you cast an ability, refund the cooldown of another, randomly selected ability by 30% of the casted ability's cooldown.

1004.name: Back To Basics
1004.desc: Your champion abilities deal 35% increased damage and you gain 70 ability haste and 35% increased healing and shielding from all sources, but your ultimate ability is permanently sealed.

2103.name: From Downtown
2103.desc:
Quest: Hit enemy champions with abilities while located at least er 600 units away from them (at the time of the hit) 15 times (counts up to 1 hit per champion per cast instance).

Reward: Upon completing your Quest, hitting enemy champions with abilities while located at least er 600 units away from them at the time of the hit fires a meteor to their current location, which upon landing deals 75 to 200 (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 20% AP) magic damage to enemies within the area (8 second cooldown per target per cast instance). The meteor's damage and radius are increased based on your distance to the target at the time of the ability hit, increasing its damage by 0 to 230 for 11 and setting its radius to 150;225;337.5;506.3;759.4;1139.1;1708.6 units.

Maximum meteor damage is 75*2.3 to 200*2.3 (+ 50*2.3% bonus AD) (+ 20*2.3% AP).

1180.name: Big Brain
1180.desc: Gain a shield that absorbs damage equal to 300% AP and lasts until destroyed. Shield is replenished upon respawn and every 70 seconds.

1006.name: Blade Waltz
1006.desc:
Replace a summoner spell with 20px|link= Blade Waltz.

Blade Waltz: Blink to the target enemy champion. You then blink to the nearest other enemy champion every 0.25 seconds over the next 1.75 seconds, blinking up to 7 additional times. The last blink targets the primary target. Each time you blink to an enemy, deal 30 to 150 (+ 10% bonus AD) (+ 6% AP) physical damage to them and apply on-hit effects at 50% effectiveness, up to a total of 30*6 to 150*6 (+ 10*6% bonus AD) (+ 6*6% AP) (45 second cooldown).

While Blade Waltz is active, you are untargetable and unable to act. This effect will end prematurely if there are no longer any nearby valid targets to blink to. An enemy can be blinked to more than once if there are no other valid targets in range.

1103.name: Bread And Butter
1103.desc: Your champion's first basic ability (Q) gains 100 ability haste.

1151.name: Bread and Cheese
1151.desc: Your champion's third basic ability (E) gains 100 ability haste.

1150.name: Bread And Jam
1150.desc: Your champion's second basic ability (W) gains 100 ability haste.

1011.name: Can't Touch This

names.es: Se mira pero no se toca

1011.desc: Casting your ultimate grants you invulnerability for 2 seconds (8 second cooldown).

1013.name: Celestial Body
1013.desc: Gain 1500 bonus health, but reduce your damage output by 10%.

1015.name: Circle of Death
1015.desc: Healing and health regeneration you do causes you to deal 70% of that value in magic damage to the nearest enemy champion within 1000 units.

1310.name: Clown College
1310.desc:
Gain Shaco Backstab, Deceive and Hallucinate explosion. Replace a summoner spell with Deceive.

20px|link= Passive - Backstab: Your basic attacks deal 20 to 35 (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 35% AP) bonus physical damage on-hit when hitting an enemy from behind.

20px|link= Active - Deceive: Become invisible for up to 3 seconds and blink to the target location within 400 units after a 0.125-second delay. Your next basic attack while in stealth deals 100 (+ 150% bonus AD) (+ 55% AP) bonus physical damage, increased to155% damageif 20px|link= Backstab was applied (45 second cooldown).

20px|link= Passive - Hallucinate Death: Upon your death, release an explosion in a cr 350 radius of your death location, dealing true damage equal to 25% of target's maximum health to enemies within the area. Additionally, you deploy a Jack in the Box at the location of your death that instantly fears nearby enemies for 1 second. This box does not attack but lasts for 3 seconds.

1018.name: Courage of the Colossus
1018.desc: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants a shield for 3 seconds that absorbs 150 to 450 (+ 4% maximum health) damage (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Shields can stack between multiple triggers of this effect, though not refreshing the duration of previous shields.

1118.name: Critical Healing
1118.desc: Your heals and shields now have a chance equal to your critical strike chance to increase in effectiveness by 40% (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

1323.name: Cruelty
1323.desc:
Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion summons a comet above them that lands at their current location after 1 second, dealing 50 to 150 (+ 40% AP) (+ 4% of your maximum health) magic damage to enemies within a 300 radius (6 second cooldown per cast instance).

For displacement effects, the comet will be summoned at the displacement's end location.

1019.name: Dashing
1019.desc: Abilities with dashes or blinks gain 175 ability haste.

1020.name: Dawnbringer's Resolve

names.ja: ドーンブリンガーの誓い
names.es: Valor de los guerreros del orden

1020.desc: Upon dropping below 50% maximum health, you are healed for30/12% of your maximum health every 0.25 secondsover 3 seconds (45 second cooldown, reset upon death).

1025.name: Dive Bomber
1025.desc: Upon death, you explode to deal true damage equal to 20% of the target's maximum health to enemies within 500 units.

2099.name: Rite of Ascension
2099.desc: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them causes them to leave behind their Essence for 8 seconds. You can basic attack the Essence within 400 units to consume it: causing you to blink to its location after winding up for 1.25 seconds, during which you are untargetable (except to turrets), displacement immune, and unable to act. Upon consumption of the Essence, you gain 100% bonus movement speed decaying over 2 seconds, heal yourself for 75 to 300 (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 25% AP), and reset the cooldowns of your basic abilities. The heal is increased by 0 to 100 for 11, for a maximum heal of 75*2 to 300*2 (+ 50*2% bonus AD) (+ 25*2% AP).

1301.name: Divine Intervention
1301.desc: Automatically cast Cosmic Radiance, calling down a protective star upon you that descends over 2.5 seconds. Afterwards, you and all allied champions within cr 400 units become invulnerable for 2.5 seconds (35 second cooldown).

1026.name: Don't Blink
1026.desc: Deal 1% increased damage per 10 movement speed you have more than the target.

2010.name: Double Tap
2010.desc: Basic attacks that critically strike apply on-hit effects an additional time. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

1134.name: Draw Your Sword
1134.desc:
Become melee, modifying your attack range to 200 (+ 100% bonus attack range from augments) units. Additionally, gain 24% bonus attack damage, 20% bonus attack speed, 24% bonus health, 20% bonus movement speed, and 20% life steal. These bonuses are increased by 0 to 100 for 11.

This augment is only available for ranged champions.

1225.name: Dual Wield
1225.desc: Your basic attacks launch a bolt at the target that fires after a Estimated on-attack, deals 40% of the triggering attack's Damage calculated before modifiers damage, and applies on-hit effects at 40% effectiveness. Additionally, increase your total attack speed by 10%.

1027.name: Earthwake
1027.desc:
Dashing or blinking causes you to leave behind a trail cr from the location you moved to your destination that detonates after 0.75 seconds in a 300 radius, dealing 90 to 250 (+ 125% bonus AD) (+ 60% AP) physical damage per explosion to enemies hit, reduced to 70% against minions. Enemies can be affected only once every second from all cast instances, and the effect is not triggered if you move beyond 2000 units with the dash or blink.

This augment is only offered to up to 2 players on each team for a given game.

2004.name: Empowered By The Faithful
2004.desc: Granting a heal or shield to an allied champion blesses them for 8 seconds. Whenever a blessed ally damages an enemy champion, you generate a stack of Devotion, stacking up to 50 times. Upon reaching maximum stacks, you unleash a shockwave that expands from your location in a massive radius and deals 50 to 300 (+ 750% heal and shield power) magic damage to enemies hit. Enemy champions damaged below a percentage of their maximum health equal to 25% of your heal and shield power are executed.

2098.name: En Passant
2098.desc:
You can now identify the Vitals of enemy champions within Estimated, marked as an arc around them and pointing towards a specific direction. Dealing damage to a target with a basic attack or ability while you are facing in the direction of their exposed Vital will consume it, dealing bonus true damage equal to 6% (+ 1.5% per En Passant stack) of the target's maximum health, healing you for 50 to 200 (+ 5% missing health), and granting you 50% (+ 5% per En Passant stack) bonus movement speed that decays over 2 seconds. Consuming a target's Vital also grants you an En Passant stack for 8 seconds, refreshing on subsequent Vital triggers and stacking up a number of times. Each En Passant stack increases the consumed Vital damage and bonus movement speed.

Vitals on targets become exposed instantly once you are within range and remain exposed until you die. Once a target's Vital is consumed, you identify a new Vital on them pointing in a different direction from the previous after 4 seconds.

1028.name: Erosion
1028.desc: Each instance of damage dealt to an enemy reduces their armor and magic resistance by 1.5% for 4 seconds, stacking up to 20 times for a total of 30% resistances reduction.

1029.name: Ethereal Weapon
1029.desc: Your abilities apply on-hit effects (1 second cooldown per target).

1030.name: Eureka
1030.desc: Gain ability haste equal to 30% AP.

1194.name: Fey Magic
1194.desc: Damaging enemies with your ultimate ability polymorphs them into harmless critters for 2 seconds, during which their base movement speed is reduced by 60, and disarms them for the same duration (15 second cooldown per target).

1036.name: Firebrand
1036.desc: Basic attacks on-hit apply a Burn for 5 seconds that deals bonus magic damage equal to2% of the target's maximum health over the duration.This Burn stacks infinitely and refreshes with each application.

1308.name: FireFox

names.ja: ファイヤーフォックス

1308.desc: Automatically cast a modified version of Fox-Fire, gaining 25% bonus movement speed that decays over 2 seconds and conjuring 3 flames that orbit you clockwise for up to 2.5 seconds at a radius of cr 150 units. The flames will On a 0.25-second delay after acquisition the nearest visible enemies within cr 550 units, dealing 35 to 160 (+ 25% bonus AD (+ 25% AP) adaptive damage, reduced to30% of the original damagefor enemies hit by subsequent flames from the same cast (7 second cooldown).

1187.name: Flashbang
1187.desc:
Using Flash creates an explosion around the blink location that deals 70 to 240 (+ 70% AD) (+ 60% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 35% for 1.25 seconds. Additionally, the cooldown of your Flash resets upon your death.

This augment cannot be rolled unless you have the Flashy augment. If Flash is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Flash.

1116.name: Flashy
1116.desc:
Your Flash now has 3 charges with a 1.18 seconds after applying the 70 summoner spell haste from the global ARAM champion buff between casts (120 seconds recharge time for all 3 charges).

If Flash is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Flash.

1038.name: From Beginning To End
1038.desc: Gain the Dark Harvest and First Strike keystone runes.

1322.name: Get Excited!
1322.desc: Scoring a champion takedown grants you 100% bonus movement speed and 15% total attack speed for 4 seconds.

1195.name: Giant Slayer

names.ja: ジャイアント スレイヤー

1195.desc: Become tiny, reducing your size by 75% and granting you 20% bonus movement speed. Additionally, deal 10;15;25;30 bonus damage against enemy champions with greater size than you.

1041.name: Goliath
1041.desc: Grants 35% bonus health, 15% adaptive force, and 50% increased size.

1181.name: Heavy Hitter
1181.desc: Basic attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to 3.5% of your maximum health.

2107.name: Hellbent
2107.desc:
Generate a stack of Revivemaxxing for each enemy champion you hit with basic attacks on-hit or abilities, lasting for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits, and stacking up to 10 times. At maximum stacks, you become Hellbent.

Hellbent: Upon taking lethal damage, you enter resurrection for 4 seconds, during which you are invulnerable, untargetable, and unable to act. Afterwards, you revive with 35 to 75 of your maximum health (90 second cooldown). Additionally, you become empowered for the next 15 seconds, granting you 25*0.6 to 200*0.6 bonus Attack Damage or 25 to 200 Ability Power (Adaptive), 20 to 40 bonus movement speed while facing toward nearby enemy champions, and 15 to 30 omnivamp for the duration.

1105.name: Homeguard
1105.desc: Gain 100% bonus movement speed. This bonus is lost for 6 seconds after taking damage.

1044.name: Ice Cold
1044.desc: Your slowing effects reduce the movement speed of targets by an additional 75.

1001.name: Titan's Resolve
1001.desc:
You generate a stack of Juggernauting for each instance of damage you deal or take (excluding damage over time), lasting for 6 seconds and refreshing on subsequent damage dealt or taken. For every 7 stacks of Juggernauting, you gain 25*0.6 to 75*0.6 bonus Attack Damage or 25 to 75 Ability Power (Adaptive), 5 to 10 bonus armor and bonus magic resistance, 10% increased size, and 8% tenacity.

Stacks expire one by one when the duration ends, with the decay rate being faster the more stacks you have.

1149.name: Impassable
1149.desc: Gain the Aftershock and Glacial Augment keystone runes.

1045.name: Infernal Conduit
1045.desc:
Your ability hits against champions apply a Burn for 3 seconds that deals6 to 60 (+ 14% bonus AD) (+ 6% AP) bonus magic damage over the duration(1 second cooldown per cast instance). This Burn stacks infinitely and refreshes with each application.

Additionally, all of your Burn effects reduce the cooldowns of all your basic abilities by 0.08 seconds for each tick of damage they deal to a target.

1046.name: Infernal Soul

names.ja: インファーナルソウル

1046.desc: Grants the Infernal Dragon Soul, or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.

2005.name: Triggered Inferno

names.ja: 巻き起こるインフェルノ

2005.desc:
Your damaging basic attacks and abilities against at least one enemy champion unique from the previous damaging hit made against champions generate a stack of Style for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent unique or non-unique hits and stacking up to 7 times. For each stack, gain 4.25 to 5 for 4 bonus movement speed, up to a maximum of 4.25*7 to 5*7 for 4.

Upon reaching maximum Style stacks, if an enemy champion is within range, you unleash a torrent of shots for 2.25. Over the first 2, you rapidly shoot at enemies within 600 units at sporadic times in on average; total of 5 intervals of 0.231 and 5 of 0.198 seconds each (up to 10 times per enemy), dealing 20 to 40 (+ 40% AD) (+ 25% AP) physical damage with each shot, reduced by 75% against minions. Enemies below 30% of their maximum health are critically struck for20*2 to 40*2 (+ 40*2% AD) (+ 25*2% AP) physical damage(5 second cooldown). This effect ends prematurely if you become affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.

Style stacks are represented by grades (20px|link=→20px|link=→20px|link=→20px|link=→20px|link=→20px|link=→20px|link=). The stacks are consumed at the end of the shooting effect. Shot damage applies life steal.

1211.name: It's Killing Time
1211.desc: Upon casting your ultimate ability, you apply Death Mark to all enemy champions (8 second cooldown). The mark stores 40% of all Damage calculated before modifiers damage you deal to the affected target, detonating after 5 seconds to deal true damage equal to the damage stored against them.

1048.name: Jeweled Gauntlet

names.ja: ジュエル ガントレット

1048.desc:
Your abilities can now critically strike for (145% + bonus critical strike damage) damage. Additionally, gain 25% (+ 4.5% per 100 AP) critical strike chance.

If both Jeweled Gauntlet and 20px|link=|An icon for the ARAM: Mayhem augment Vulnerability Vulnerability are equipped, only rolls the critical strike chance of the augment that has the higher critical damage (or either if equal).

2016.name: Juiced
2016.desc: Basic attacks against enemy champions deal bonus magic damage on-hit equal to 7% of your maximum mana. This damage can critically strike for 100 bonus damage.

1305.name: Leg Day
1305.desc: Gain 50 bonus movement speed and 50% slow resist.

1051.name: Light 'Em Up!
1051.desc: Basic attacks on-hit generate a stack, up to 4. The fourth stack consumes them all to quickly launch 4 missiles at the target that each deal 11 to 80 (+ 35% bonus AD) (+ 19% AP) bonus magic damage on-hit, for a total of 11*4 to 80*4 (+ 35*4% bonus AD) (+ 19*4% AP).

1053.name: Mad Scientist
1053.desc: Upon acquiring this augment and each time you respawn, gain either 30% adaptive force, 20% bonus health, and 40% increased size or 70 ability haste, 40% bonus movement speed, and 40% reduced size.

1133.name: Magic Missile
1133.desc: Dealing damage to an enemy champion with an ability fires 3 missiles at them that each deal true damage equal to 0.33% of the target's maximum health, increased to up to 1% based on distance travelled (maximum damage reached at 1000 units). This effect can only trigger once every 6 seconds from the same cast.

1129.name: Marksmage
1129.desc: Basic attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to 75% AP.

1054.name: Master of Duality
1054.desc: Basic attacks on-hit grant 6 to 18 ability power and damaging abilities once per cast instance grant 3 to 9 bonus attack damage, lasting for 5 seconds, with the duration of both refreshing on subsequent hits, and stacking infinitely.

1056.name: Mind to Matter
1056.desc: Grants bonus health equal to 50% maximum mana.

1104.name: Minionmancer
1104.desc: Your pets deal 40% increased damage as well as gain 40% bonus health and size.

1057.name: Mountain Soul
1057.desc: Grants the Mountain Dragon Soul, or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.

2055.name: Multishot
2055.desc:
Assigns quests that require you to hit enemy champions with a specific ability's missile a number of times (counts up to 1 hit per champion per cast instance). There are six quest tiers, and each completed tier rewards you with an additional missile fired on the ability's cast. The reward effect also modifies the ability to fire all of its missiles in a cone. Subsequent missile hits from the same cast against the same enemy deal 30% damage.

Hit requirements as denoted below are rounded down to whole numbers, with a minimum value of 1.

1058.name: Mystic Punch
1058.desc: Basic attacks on-hit reduce the remaining cooldowns of your abilities by 1.25 seconds.

1060.name: Ocean Soul
1060.desc: Grants the Ocean Dragon Soul, which has a modified base heal value of 100, or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.

1061.name: Ok Boomerang
1061.desc: Automatically cast an improved version of Boomerang Blade at the closest nearby enemy champion within 1250 units, dealing 40 to 200 (+ 30% bonus AD) (+ 20% AP) adaptive damage to enemies hit (10 second cooldown).

1063.name: Outlaw's Grit
1063.desc: Dashing or blinking grants 12 bonus armor and bonus magic resistance for 15 seconds, stacking up to 5 times for a total of 60 bonus resistances, and refreshing on subsequent triggers.

1311.name: Overflow
1311.desc: Your abilities' mana costs are doubled, but you also gain 10% (+ 0.5% per 100 maximum mana) increased damage as well as self and outgoing healing and shielding.

12317.name: Pandora's Box
12317.desc: Gain one random Prismatic-tier augment. Additionally, your current augments transform into an equal number of completely random Prismatic-tier ones.

1390.name: Phenomenal Evil
1390.desc:
Gain Phenomenal Evil Power.

Phenomenal Evil Power: Generate a permanent stack of Phenomenal Evil each time you damage an enemy champion with ability damage. This effect cannot trigger more than once every second globally and once every 3 seconds from the same cast instance. For each stack, gain 1 ability power.

If this is not your first augment, start with 40 Phenomenal Evil stacks, granting you 40 ability power.

1324.name: Protein Shake
1324.desc: Gain 25% (+ 35% per 100 bonus armor) (+ 35% per 100 bonus magic resistance) heal and shield power.

2018.name: Purist - Caster
2018.desc: Convert all of your bonus attack speed into ability haste at a rate of 0.65 ability haste per 1% bonus attack speed. Additionally, your abilities' total cooldowns are reduced by 10%.

names.pl: Ze Stali Niech Będzie Twe Serce

names.ja: アーフのチャンピオン
ウーグレット ウィッチキャップ

2064.name: Quickstep
2064.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to cause you to dash up to 350 units towards your cursor.

1067.name: Rejuvenation
1067.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to heal you for 30 to 100 (+ 25% bonus AD) (+ 15% AP) (+ 5% bonus health). This is increased by up to 50% based on how long the ability's cooldown is, for a maximum heal of 30*1.5 to 100*1.5 (+ 25*1.5% bonus AD) (+ 15*1.5% AP) (+ 5*1.5% bonus health).

1072.name: Searing Dawn
1072.desc:
Gain Sunlight.

Sunlight: Your damaging abilities mark enemies, causing them to take 40 to 200 bonus magic damage from your ally's next basic attack or ability hit against them (0.75-second cooldown per target).

1073.name: Shadow Runner
1073.desc: After dashing, blinking, or exiting stealth, gain 300 bonus movement speed for 2 seconds.

1074.name: Shrink Ray
1074.desc: Basic attacks on-hit reduce the target's damage dealt by 15% for 3 seconds, refreshing with each hit. Their size is also reduced significantly for the duration.

1113.name: Skilled Sniper
1113.desc: Hitting an enemy champion with a basic ability while located at least er 600 units away from them at the time of the hit reduces its current cooldown by 80% of its total cooldown, modified to 65% for damage over time abilities.

1136.name: Slap Around
1136.desc: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants you 10, stacking infinitely (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Lose 50% of stacks on death.

2088.name: Snowday
2088.desc:
Your Mark deals 100% increased damage and has its cooldown reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste.

If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.

1076.name: Sonic Boom
1076.desc: Granting a buff, heal, or shield to your ally deals 30 to 150 true damage to enemies within 450 units of them and slows targets by 30% for 2 seconds (2 second cooldown).

1077.name: Soul Siphon
1077.desc: Heal for 12% of the Damage calculated after modifiers dealt by your critical strikes. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

2100.name: Pursuit of Haste
2100.desc: Assigns quests that require you to hit enemy champions with a specific ability a number of times (counts up to 1 hit per champion per cast instance). There are two quest tiers, and each completed tier rewards you with ability haste on the ability.

1214.name: Spin To Win
1214.desc: Your Any ability with 'spinning' properties deal 30% increased damage and have their cooldown reduced equivalent to 30 ability haste. The damage amplifier is increased to 50% for ultimate abilities.

2104.name: Spirit Bomb
2104.desc:
Your healing and shielding on yourself or allies builds up a Spirit Bomb on top of you. Once you have healed and shielded a combined total of 200 to 2000, you toss the Spirit Bomb onto the Lowest health percent allied champion over 1.1 seconds. Upon impact, the Spirit Bomb explodes in a 475 radius to heal allied champions within the area for 5 to 15 (+ 3% per 100 AP) of their missing health and grants them a shield for 2 seconds that absorbs damage equal to 10 to 25 (+ 2% per 100 AP) of their current health.

Healing and shielding from this effect do not count toward the Spirit Bomb's trigger condition.

1204.name: Stackosaurus Rex

names.ja: スタックサウルス・レックス

1204.desc: Increase the number of permanent stacks you gain from abilities by 100%.

1403.name: Stats on Stats!

names.ja: ステータス上のステータス！

1403.desc: Gain 3 Stat Bonus, with a higher chance of obtaining Gold- and Prismatic-tier anvils.

1402.name: Stats on Stats on Stats!

names.ja: ステータス上のステータス上のステータス！

1402.desc: Gain 4 Stat Bonus, with a higher chance of obtaining Gold- and Prismatic-tier anvils. Additionally, on the next round of augment selection, you gain an additional reroll per augment slot.

1413.name: Stuck In Here With Me

names.ja: 一緒に閉じ込められた

1413.desc:
Casting your ultimate ability grants you an aura for 2 seconds, growing in size over the duration to up to 500 units. After the duration, you taunt all enemies within the aura for 2 seconds and gain 50% damage reduction for the same duration (30 second cooldown). Additionally, gain 30 ultimate haste.

Aura is activated once the ultimate's effect For instant-cast spells or has For duration-based spells.

2073.name: Siphon
2073.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability to heal you for 30% of its Damage calculated after modifiers dealt to enemy champions.

1079.name: Symphony of War
1079.desc: Gain the Conqueror and Lethal Tempo keystone runes.

1353.name: Tank Engine
1353.desc: Scoring a champion takedown generates a stack, stacking infinitely. For each stack, increase your maximum health and size by 5%. Lose 65% of stacks on death.

1080.name: Tank It Or Leave It
1080.desc:
Gain Critical Defend Chance equal to 100% critical strike chance, up to 50%. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

Critical Defend Chance: Grants you a chance to reduce an instance of damage taken by 20% (5 second cooldown per enemy spell cast instance).

1081.name: Tap Dancer
1081.desc: Basic attacks on-hit against enemy champions and minions grant 10 bonus movement speed, lasting for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent triggers, and stacking infinitely. Additionally, gain bonus attack speed equal to 10% total movement speed.

2065.name: Terror
2065.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to fear all enemies within 450 units of you for 1.75 seconds (30 second cooldown).

1084.name: Thread the Needle
1084.desc: Grants 18% armor penetration and magic penetration.

1243.name: Transmute: Chaos
1243.desc: Gain two completely random augments, excluding the other two offerings in your current assortment.

1087.name: Typhoon
1087.desc: Basic attacks launch a missile at a nearby enemy, prioritizing champions, that deals 30% AD physical damage and applies on-hit effects.

1088.name: Ultimate Revolution
1088.desc: Casting your ultimate ability resets its cooldown once its effect For instant-cast spells or has For duration-based spells (75 second cooldown, reset upon death).

1112.name: Ultimate Unstoppable

names.ja: 破竹のアルティメット
names.vi: Chiêu Cuối Không Thể Cản Phá

1112.desc: Casting your ultimate ability grants you crowd control immunity for 3 seconds (8 second cooldown).

1320.name: Upgrade Collector

names.ja: コレクター アップグレード

1320.desc: Upgrades The Collector, empowering Death to have its execution threshold increased by 0.5% each time you kill an enemy champion, capped at a threshold of 12.5% of the target's maximum health, and Taxes to generate a further 25 (total 50) from kills. Additionally, gain 250.

1336.name: Upgrade Infinity Edge

names.ja: インフィニティ エッジ アップグレード

1336.desc:
Upgrades Infinity Edge, empowering it to gain Sword of the Divine Excoriate. Additionally, gain 500.

Excoriate: Gain a random amount of bonus critical strike damage that scales up to 50% of your critical strike chance, with the value of this amount changing every 0.25 seconds.

1319.name: Upgrade Immolate

names.ja: 猛火 アップグレード

1319.desc: Upgrades Bami's Cinder, Hollow Radiance, Sunfire Aegis, and Void Immolation, empowering Immolate to additionally grant you 12 per tick for each enemy champion afflicted by its effect. Additionally, gain 250.

1996.name: Upgrade Sheen

names.ja: シーン アップグレード

1996.desc: Upgrades all Spellblade items, empowering the passive effect to deal additional bonus physical damage equal to 4% of the target's maximum health and heal you for 3.5% of the target's maximum health. Additionally, gain 250.

1318.name: Upgrade Zhonya's

names.ja: ゾーニャ アップグレード
names.es: Mejora de Reloj de arena de Zhonya

1318.desc: Upgrades Seeker's Armguard, Wooglet's Witchcap, and Zhonya's Hourglass, empowering Stasis to cleanse you of all crowd control and allow you to move during its active effect, during which time you also gain 50% bonus movement speed. Additionally, the cooldown of Zhonya's Hourglass Stasis is reduced to 45 seconds.

1092.name: Vulnerability
1092.desc:
Damage dealt by items and damage over time effects can now critically strike for (145% + bonus critical strike damage) damage (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

If both 20px|link=|An icon for the ARAM: Mayhem augment Jeweled Gauntlet Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability are equipped, only rolls the critical strike chance of the augment that has the higher critical damage (or either if equal).

1005.name: Wee Woo Wee Woo
1005.desc: Gain 0 to 50 for 11 (based on target ally's missing health) bonus movement speed while facing toward nearby allied champions, lingering for 2 seconds after no longer facing them. Your heals and shields are also increased by 0 to 50 for 11.

1095.name: Windspeaker's Blessing
1095.desc: Your heals and shields on yourself or allies grant the target 30 to 60 bonus armor and bonus magic resistance for 3 seconds.

1098.name: With Haste
1098.desc: Grants bonus movement speed equal to 70% ability haste.

2009.name: Zealot
2009.desc: Gain 35% (+ 5% per 100 AP) bonus attack speed and 25% (+ 5% per 100 AP) critical strike chance.

1206.name: escAPADe
1206.desc: Convert all of your ability power into bonus attack damage at a rate of 1 bonus attack damage per 1.66 ability power. Additionally, increase your total attack damage by 15%.

2062.name: Echo Cast
2062.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to summon a clone of your champion that is untargetable and moves up to 500 units towards your cursor. The clone then casts the ability it was summoned from after a 0.25-second delay, mimicking the active effects of the casted spell and disappearing after it finishes casting.

names.ja: アーケイン アクシオム

3049.name: Armored Impact
3049.desc: After casting an ability, your next basic attack on-hit within 10 seconds is empowered to deal 25 to 125 (+ 220% bonus armor) bonus physical damage to the target and surrounding enemies.

3018.name: Big Shot
3018.desc:
Convert 75% of your total attack speed into critical strike damage, at a rate of 0.67% critical strike damage per 1% attack speed. Additionally, you gain 25% bonus attack damage and 35% critical strike damage.

Critical strike damage granted from this effect only applies to basic attacks that critically strike.

1329.name: Biggest Snowball Ever

names.es: La bola más grande de la historia
names.pt: A Maior Bola de Neve de Todas!
names.it: La palla di neve più grande di sempre!

1329.desc:
Upgrades your Mark into a massive snowball, empowering it with an increased size radius and the ability to pass through non-champions. The snowball additionally explodes upon impact of the target hit to deal 200 to 350 (+ 100% bonus AD) (+ 60% AP) magic damage to all nearby enemies, knock them up for 0.75 seconds, and slow them by 20% for 2 seconds. Additionally, your Mark cooldown is reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste.

If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark. Non-champions hit by the snowball are stunned for 1.25 seconds.

3051.name: Blue Barrier
3051.desc: Gain a shield equal to 200 to 450 of mana spent for 1.5 seconds. Shields can stack between multiple triggers of this effect, though not refreshing the duration of previous shields. Each shield instance is capped at a strength of 300 to 800.

2111.name: BONK!
2111.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has an empowered basic attack effect, further enhancing the attack to deal 30% increased damage to the target and 30% of its damage to nearby enemies.

3071.name: Brass Blast
3071.desc: After casting an ability, your next basic attack on-hit within 6 seconds is empowered to gain 200% bonus attack speed, deal 50 to 200 (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 30% AP) bonus magic damage, and grant you 75 to 150 bonus movement speed decaying over 2 seconds.

2083.name: Tooth Fairy
2083.desc: When you deal Damage calculated after modifiers to an enemy champion equal to or more than 25% of their maximum health within 2.5 seconds, they drop a Tooth on the ground (4 second cooldown per target). You can pick up this Tooth by moving over it, granting you a Dental Records stack. For each stack, you gain 3 lethality and flat magic penetration.

2078.name: Chain Reaction
2078.desc:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a knock back effect, empowering the ability to trigger a chain reaction effect when displaced champions hit other champions or terrain within 200 units. If a knocked back champion collides with another enemy champion during their displacement, the champions they collided with are dealt 100 to 400 magic damage and knocked up for 0.5 seconds. If they collide with terrain during their displacement, they will rebound to take 150 to 800 magic damage and become knocked up for 0.75 seconds and stunned for 0.5 seconds. The knock up duration is increased to up to 1.1 seconds based on how long the ability's cooldown is.

If the upgraded ability is an ultimate, this effect deals 250% damage, increasing the champion collision damage to 100*2.5 to 400*2.5 and the terrain collision damage to 150*2.5 to 800*2.5.

names.ja: クリムゾン・コバルト

1328.name: Critical Rhythm
1328.desc: Your critical strikes grant you 6% bonus attack speed for 6 seconds, stacking up to 10 times for a total of 60%. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

2077.name: Ravenous Bind
2077.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a immobilizing or grounding effect, empowering the ability to deal 15 to 90 (+ 10% AP) (+ 0.5% of your maximum health) magic damage to affected targets and heal you for 75 to 300 (+ 5% AP) (+ 12% bonus health). The heal is increased by up to 50% based on how long the ability's cooldown is.

2131.name: Don't Change the Channel

names.ja: チャンネルはそのまま

2131.desc: For every second that you channel an ability, you gain a 50 to 200 (+ 50% AD) (+ 25% AP) (+ 10% bonus health) shield. The shield quickly decays once you stop channeling.

2144.name: Bolstered
2144.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a shield effect, increasing the strength of the ability's shield by 0 to 60 for 11.

3036.name: Double Time
3036.desc: Dealing damage to an enemy champion with two separate abilities within 4 seconds causes the second ability to deal bonus magic damage equal to 10% maximum mana and permanently increase your maximum mana by 25 (4 second cooldown per target).

1331.name: Empyrean Promise
1331.desc:
Replace a summoner spell with Empyrean Promise Vigilance active. Additionally, gain 15% heal and shield power.

Active - Vigilance: After a 0.25-second delay, dash to the current location of the target allied champion and gain a 100 to 250 (+ 100% AP) (+ 10% bonus health) shield for 3 seconds. Upon arrival, grant the ally the same shield (20 second cooldown; 2000 range).

2091.name: Endless Decimation
2091.desc: While in combat, automatically cast an improved version of Q, winding up over 1.25 seconds to slash in a cr 460 radius around you. The slash deals 100 to 400 (+ 60% AD) (+ 40% AP) physical damage to enemies within the area (8 second cooldown). Enemies within the cr 240 inner radius of the slash take100*0.5 to 400*0.5 (+ 60*0.5% AD) (+ 40*0.5% AP) physical damage.Additionally, for each enemy champion hit along the outer edge, you heal for 18% of your missing health and the cooldown of this effect is reduced by 10%, down to a minimum of 3 seconds.

1333.name: Escape Plan
1333.desc: Upon dropping below 35% maximum health, gain a shield for 65% of your maximum health for 5.5 seconds, during which you also gain 150% bonus movement speed and have reduced size (75 second cooldown). The shield and bonus movement speed decay over the duration.

1344.name: Final Form
1344.desc: Casting your ultimate ability empowers you for 10 seconds, causing you to gain a shield for 50% of your maximum health, 20% omnivamp, and 30% bonus movement speed for the duration (20 second cooldown).

2032.name: Shark Bait
2032.desc:
Upon taking fatal damage, you become a Shark Bait, causing you to enter a zombie state for 3.5 seconds, during which your movement speed is set to a static 400, you gain ghosting, and enemies within 400 units of you are slowed by 40%. At the end of the duration, a massive shark emerges from beneath you that lets out a powerful chomp (400 radius), dealing 120 to 350 (+ 30% of target's missing health) magic damage to all enemies within the area and knocking them up for 1 second.

While under the zombie state, you are able to move and become invulnerable, untargetable, and immune to crowd control, but you are also rendered unable to declare basic attacks, cast abilities, use summoner spells, and activate items.

1348.name: Flash 2
1348.desc: Replace a summoner spell with Flash. Additionally, gain 70 summoner spell haste.

2127.name: Forged By The Master

names.ja: マスターに鍛えられて

2127.desc: Increases the damage dealt by your item effects and augments by 45%.

3004.name: Get Jinxed
3004.desc:
Replace a summoner spell with Get Jinxed!.

20px|link= Get Jinxed!: geteffect

3063.name: Gift of the Drowned
3063.desc: Convert all of your bonus health into lethality at a rate of5 lethality per 100 bonus health.Additionally, gain 10 to 25 lethality.

1325.name: Glass Cannon
1325.desc: You gain a health threshold equal to 70% maximum health which cannot be By increases or decreases to maximum health nor By healing and health regeneration by any means. In return, you deal bonus true damage equal to 25% of all of the damage you deal Damage calculated before modifiers.

1392.name: Holy Snowball
1392.desc:
After using the Dash spell from Mark, you become invulnerable for 1.5 seconds upon arrival. Additionally, your Mark cooldown is reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste.

If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.

1335.name: Goldrend
1335.desc: Damaging basic attacks or abilities against enemy champions deal 50 to 150 (+ 40% bonus AD) (+ 20% AP) bonus magic damage, and grant you 30 and 25% bonus movement speed for 1.5 seconds (30 second cooldown per champion).

1401.name: Growth Spurt
1401.desc:
Replace a summoner spell with Growth Spurt.

20px|link= Growth Spurt: geteffect

1389.name: Hand of Baron
1389.desc: Gain a modified Hand of Baron, which only grants 25% increased adaptive force and greatly empowers nearby allied minions.

3052.name: Hands off the Talent

names.ja: タレントに触れないで

3052.desc: Basic attacks against enemies hit farther than 75% of your total attack range deal 15% bonus AD (+ 20% AP) bonus physical damage.

1416.name: Hextech Soul

names.ja: ヘクステック ソウル

1416.desc: Grants the Hextech Dragon Soul, or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.

1388.name: Infinite Recursion
1388.desc: Gain 60 ability haste, increased by 3 each time you score a champion takedown.

2125.name: It's Go Time
2125.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a duration-based effect, empowering the ability to grant 25 to 45 bonus movement speed for the effect's duration.

names.ja: ジュエル ブレスレット

2126.name: Reload
2126.desc:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a duration-based effect, causing basic attacks on-hit during the ability to reduce its remaining cooldown by 0.15 to 0.35 seconds.

This augment exists in the internal augment data but appears to be disabled.

2026.name: Kill Secured
2026.desc: Gain 60% bonus movement speed towards enemy champions below 40% of their maximum health.

1337.name: King Me
1337.desc:
Upon entering the enemy team's gate or Catapult for the first time, either of which are located near their spawn, you become 20px|link= Kinged, causing you to gain one random Prismatic-tier augment and the first eligible Legendary item in your inventory to be upgraded with improved stats. The gold value of all Includes AH, AP, AD, AS, AR, MR, and HP on the item is increased by exactly 1000.

King Me scans each item slot in the champion's inventory (from slots 1-6) for an eligible Legendary item, upgrading the first eligible item that is found.

2096.name: Lil' Extra Help
2096.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has an effect which empowers your basic attacks for a duration, further enhancing the attacks by granting you 150 bonus attack range and 75% bonus attack speed while the effect is active.

2133.name: Mercy's Strike
2133.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to enhance your next basic attack. The enhanced attack has 300 bonus range, gains 75% bonus attack speed, and deals bonus magic damage equal to 3% (+ 2% per 10% heal and shield power) of the target's maximum health. If the target is a turret, the damage is modified to 2.5% of the target's maximum health bonus magic damage.

1314.name: Mighty Shield
1314.desc: Gain 40 to 100 adaptive force for 3 seconds upon gaining a shield (5 second cooldown).

2072.name: Spell Split
2072.desc:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a missile, empowering the ability's missile to split in two over 0.25 seconds upon reaching maximum range, or when recast. Each of the split missiles fire perpendicularly in opposite directions and apply the same effects to enemies they hit. Subsequent missile hits from the same cast against the same enemy deal 30% damage.

Recast can be used after 0.15 seconds of the initial cast.

3053.name: Mosh Monster
3053.desc: Casting your ultimate ability grants you 300 to 750 bonus health on-cast and slows enemies within 350 units of you by 50% while it is active. Additionally, scoring a takedown against an enemy champion permanently increases the bonus health gained by 15 to 30 and expands the radius of the slow, tripled if the takedown was scored while your ultimate was active.

2043.name: Nature is Healing

names.ja: 大自然が回復している

2043.desc: Upon entering a patch of brush, you are healed for40/6 to 300/6 (+ 15/6% of your missing health) every 0.25 secondsover 1.5 seconds (20 second cooldown per brush patch).

1326.name: Nightstalking
1326.desc: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them renders you invisible for 1.5 seconds, during which you also gain 40% bonus movement speed. Attacking or casting abilites ends the stealth immediately.

3059.name: No Mana, No Problem

names.fr: Pas de mana, pas de problème
names.vi: Hết Năng Lượng, Không Vấn Đề

3059.desc: Convert all of the mana you gain from items into ability power at a rate of 0.8 ability power per 10 mana from items. Additionally, increase your ability power by 15%.

1332.name: Ominous Pact
1332.desc: Your abilities now have a health cost of 5% current health to cast them. In return, you gain ability power based on your missing health, up to 75 to 150 at 70% missing health, 0 to 50 for 11 (based on missing health) bonus movement speed, and 0 to 20 for 11 (based on missing health) omnivamp.

2119.name: Overextender
2119.desc:
Your launch with the Cannon Launcher is now empowered, increasing the launch range by 12,000 units and the impact damage by 50%, as well as the travel speed by a significant amount. Additionally, your Recall is now functional and is upgraded to Empowered Recall.

This augment is only available on the 20px|link= Butcher's Bridge map.

Total launch range is 18,500 units, reduced to 16,500 after your team's Outer turret is destroyed. Increased impact damage is 120*1.5 to 460*1.5 magic damage.

2135.name: Pin Cushion
2135.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a duration-based effect, empowering it to cause basic attacks during the ability's effect to apply Nail stacks against enemy champions. At the end of the ability's duration, or if you die, the stacks on all targets are consumed, dealing 20 to 60 physical damage per Nail stack on the target. If this effect would deal lethal damage to the target, the stacks are consumed immediately. Additionally, once a target's stacks are consumed, you gain 10 bonus movement speed per consumed stack for 3 seconds.

2123.name: Overloaded
2123.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability to have its cooldown reset whenever you cast a different ability.

2137.name: Pat On The Back
2137.desc: Whenever you are within 200 units of an allied champion, they pat you on the back, granting you a 50 to 150 (+ 25% bonus movement speed) shield and 30% bonus movement speed for 3 seconds (9 second cooldown). Subsequent passes only refresh the duration of the effects.

2139.name: Porcupine
2139.desc: You build up a burst of needles from within you when taking damage from enemy champions, storing up to 400 to 3900 Damage calculated before modifiers taken. After reaching the maximum damage stored, you consume the stored damage to burst the needles outward in a 400 radius, dealing 75 to 200 (+ 125% bonus armor) (+ 125% bonus magic resistance) physical damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds.

1358.name: Pinball
1358.desc:
Your Mark is empowered to instead throw a pinball, which deals 100 to 500 bonus true damage and ricochets off of terrain that it collides with. Each time the pinball ricochets, its remaining travel distance is reset, it increases in radius by 25%, deals 20% increased damage, and reduces Mark remaining cooldown by 30%. The pinball can ricochet up to 4 times, for a maximum radius increase of 100% and a damage increase of 80%. Additionally, your Mark cooldown is reduced equivalent to 50 ability haste.

If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.

1347.name: Poltergeist
1347.desc:
Replace a summoner spell with Poltergeist.

20px|link= Poltergeist: geteffect

1421.name: Prom Queen
1421.desc:
Automatically cast a modified version of The Quickness, empowering you to break into a captivating sprint for 6 seconds. While empowered, you gain ghosting and 50% bonus movement speed, and enemies you 300 unit collision radius are knocked down and become charmed for 1.5 seconds (35 second cooldown).

A sparkly tiara will descend upon you 2.5 seconds before the effect activates.

2141.name: Ultra Hydra

names.ja: ウルトラ ハイドラ

2141.desc:
You can now purchase Tiamat, Profane Hydra, Ravenous Hydra, and Titanic Hydra in spite of the item limit imposed by Hydra. Purchasing a Legendary-tier Hydra item (excluding Stridebreaker) grants you a Tiamat for free.

Quest: Obtain Profane Hydra, Ravenous Hydra, and Titanic Hydra.

Reward: Upon completing your Quest, convert the items you obtained for the quest into Ultra Hydra.

3039.name: Salvation
3039.desc: Upon dropping below 50% of your maximum health, you unleash a shockwave that expands from your location over 1200 units, dealing 100 to 500 (+ 125% bonus AD) (+ 75% AP) magic damage to enemies hit and healing you and allied champions hit for 200 to 550 (+ 200% bonus AD) (+ 120% AP) (90 second cooldown). Enemy champions hit within the first 600 units of the shockwave are knocked back 450 to 100 units.

2034.name: Shark Tempest
2034.desc:
Your Mark is empowered to circle sharks around it in a 300 radius, dealing 100 to 200 magic damage to enemies it passes through as it travels and slowing targets hit by 40% for 1 second. If the missile hits an enemy champion, the sharks circle around their location in a 425 radius instead for 3 seconds, dealing30*3 to 90*3 (+ 25*3% bonus AD) (+ 15*3% AP) total magic damage over the durationto enemies within the area and slowing them by 40% for 3 seconds.

If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.

1373.name: Shrink Engine
1373.desc:
Scoring a champion takedown generates a stack, stacking infinitely. For each stack, gain 8 ability haste and 1% bonus movement speed, and reduce your size by 4%. Lose 65% of stacks on death.

Size reduction is capped at 80% (20 stacks).

2109.name: Snap Back
2109.desc:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability with a recast. Using the recast causes you to blink back to your original casting position of the ability and explode to deal 100 to 300 (+ 20% AD) (+ 20% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies.

This augment exists in the internal augment data but appears to be disabled.

2080.name: Snowblast
2080.desc:
Empowers the Dash spell from Mark to deal 100% increased damage and upon arrival cause you to knock up the target for 0.5 seconds and knock back nearby enemies. Additionally, your Mark cooldown is reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste. 

If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.

1420.name: Sonata
1420.desc:
Alternate between automatically casting a modified version of Aria of Perseverance and modified Song of Celerity, with the former being cast first (10 second cooldown).

Aria of Perseverance: Heal yourself for 60 (+ 60% AP) and send out a tone to the Based on greatest % missing health allied champion within 1000 units that heals them for the same amount. Additionally, generate an 400 unit radius, center-to-edge that grants you and tagged allied champions a 80 (+ 40% AP) shield for 1.5 seconds.

Song of Celerity: Gain 30% bonus movement speed for 7 seconds. If you take damage during this time, the duration ends prematurely once or if 3 seconds have elapsed. Additionally, generate an 400 unit radius, center-to-edge that grants tagged allied champions 20% bonus movement speed for 3 seconds.

1375.name: Soul Eater
1375.desc:
Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants you 30 bonus health, stacking infinitely (5 second cooldown per cast instance).

If this is not your first augment, gain 300 bonus health.

3025.name: Sound Barrier
3025.desc: Your shields on yourself or allies grant ghosting and 20 to 40 (+ 0.5% per 1% heal and shield power) bonus movement speed that decays over 1.5 seconds (1.5-second cooldown per target).

2116.name: Pursuit of Power
2116.desc:
Quest: Hit an enemy champion with a specific ability 10 times (counts up to 1 hit per champion per cast instance).

Reward: Upon completing your Quest, increase the damage of the ability by 30%.

2054.name: Tripleshot
2054.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that is unit-targeted and fires a missile, empowering the ability to fire its missiles at two additional enemies near the primary target. Subsequent hits from the same cast against the same enemy deal 30% damage.

2115.name: Squishy Slappy Grab

names.ja: スクイッシースラッピーグラブ

2115.desc: When an enemy champion is within 450 units of you, after a 1.5-second delay, you send out Squishy Slappy Hands that latch onto all nearby enemy champions within 800 units, forming a tether between yourself and each target for 4 seconds (30 second cooldown). While the tethers persist (950 tether radius), your next basic attack is empowered to pull all tethered enemies toward you, dealing 50 to 150 (+ 15% bonus health) magic damage to affected targets and stunning them for 0.25 seconds after the pull ends. Targets are pulled over 450 units, reduced to 350 for those farther away from you. Additionally, you gain a 100 to 300 (+ 70% bonus armor) (+ 70% bonus magic resistance) shield for each pulled enemy, lasting for 2.5 seconds.

2134.name: Surge Field
2134.desc:
Upon casting your ultimate ability, you spawn a surge zone beneath you that has a 300 radius. While you are within the zone, you gain 50 ability haste and 40% bonus movement speed, and your damage dealt to enemy champions fires missiles at them that deal 20% of the triggering damage instance Damage calculated before modifiers as bonus magic damage. The missile effect cannot trigger from itself.

The zone lasts indefinitely as long as you stay within its radius. If you leave the zone's radius for the first time, it moves to your current location. Exiting the zone a second time causes it to disappear if you do not re-enter the area within 1.25 seconds.

1315.name: Swift and Safe
1315.desc: After dashing or blinking, gain a shield that lasts for 2 seconds and absorbs 65 to 290 (+ 65% AD) (+ 26% AP) damage (5 second cooldown).

2129.name: Terrain'd
2129.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that spawns terrain, empowering the ability to deal 20 to 180 (+ 20% AP) magic damage to enemies near the terrain. This damage is increasedto 20*3 to 180*3 (+ 20*3% AP)if the ability is an ultimate.

3078.name: The Boom and the Bass
3078.name_zh: 鼓声暴起 低音轰鸣

names.zh: 鼓声暴起 低音轰鸣

3016.name: Third Times the Harm

names.ja: 二度あることは三度ある
names.es: A la tercera va la embestida

3016.desc: Your basic attacks on-hit against enemy champions apply a mark to the target for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits. Every third attack on-hit against the marked target grants you a stack and deals bonus true damage equal to 6% of the target's maximum health (+ 10 per stack you have).

3058.name: Tickle Monster

names.ja: コチョコチョ モンスター

3058.desc: Convert all of your bonus attack damage into bonus attack speed at a rate of 1.75% bonus attack speed per 1 bonus attack damage. Additionally, your basic attacks deal 5 to 50 bonus magic damage on-hit.

2076.name: Stay Resolute
2076.desc:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability to grant you 2;3 bonus armor or bonus magic resistance permanently when it damages an enemy champion, stacking infinitely (5 second cooldown per target per cast instance).

The resistance type granted is based on the target's 20px|link= adaptive type: bonus armor for physical and bonus magic resistance for magic.

If this is not your first augment, gain 20 bonus armor and bonus magic resistance.

3079.name: Totentanz
3079.desc:
After casting an ability, your next basic attack is empowered to bounce a bee from the primary target to the nearest enemy champion within 700 units of them, dealing 50 to 100 of the triggering attack's damage upon arrival.

Additionally, you are assigned with quests that require you to bounce bees onto enemy champions a number of times. There are three quest tiers, and each completed tier rewards you with bonus attack damage and an additional bee bounce on the empowered attack that repeats from the new target with each bounce, forming a chain of bee attacks.

2136.name: Trusty Weapon
2136.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability to generate a Friendship stack for 6 seconds when it hits an enemy champion, stacking infinitely. For each Friendship stack you have, the ability deals 5% increased damage.

1415.name: Twin Fire
1415.desc: Damaging abilities against enemy champions launch 1 (+ 1 per 33.33% critical strike chance) missiles at the target that each deal 10 to 30 (+ 7% bonus AD) (+ 7% AP) magic damage (5 second cooldown). Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

1349.name: Ultimate Awakening
1349.desc: Casting your ultimate ability resets the cooldowns of all your basic abilities and grants you 300 basic ability haste for 15 seconds (20 second cooldown). Additionally, gain 30 ultimate haste.

2157.name: Upgrade Death's Dance

names.ja: デスダンス アップグレード
names.es: Mejora de Baile de la muerte
names.vi: Nâng Cấp Vũ Điệu Tử Thần

2157.desc: Upgrades Death's Dance, empowering Ignore Pain with an increased damage reduction of 40% and Defy with an increased heal AD ratio of 125% bonus AD. Defy's healing is also granted instantly upon the passive effect being triggered rather than over 2 seconds. Additionally, gain 250.

2140.name: Upgrade Ravenous Hydra

names.ja: ラヴァナス ハイドラ アップグレード

2140.desc: Upgrades Ravenous Hydra, increasing its life steal stat to 20% and empowering Cleave to trigger its effect on ability hits against enemies (1 second cooldown per ability). Additionally, gain 500.

names.ja: ストームサージ アップグレード
names.vi: Nâng Cấp Quyền Trượng Bão Tố

2143.name: Upgrade Sundered Sky

names.ja: サンダード スカイ アップグレード

2143.desc: Upgrades Sundered Sky, empowering Lightshield Strike with an increased heal health ratio of 9% of your missing health and a reduced cooldown of 5 seconds. Additionally, gain 500.

1379.name: Upgrade Sword of Blossoming Dawn

names.ja: 花咲く夜明けの剣 アップグレード
names.es: Mejora de Espada del amanecer floreciente
names.vi: Nâng Cấp Kiếm Bình Minh Nở Rộ

1379.desc: Upgrades Sword of Blossoming Dawn, empowering Peppermint to have its healing increased by 250%. Additionally, you gain 100% bonus attack speed.

1034.name: Veil of Warding

names.ja: ワーディングヴェール

1034.desc: Grants a spell shield that blocks the next hostile ability (30 second cooldown, timer does not restart from champion damage taken).

2138.name: Adaptive Ward
2138.desc:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability to grant you 7 to 12 bonus armor or bonus magic resistance for 6 seconds when it hits an enemy champion (4 second cooldown). This effect can stack up to a number of times.

The resistance type granted is based on the target's 20px|link= adaptive type: bonus armor for physical and bonus magic resistance for magic.

names.ja: 大魔導師のジュースボックス

1386.name: Spin Me Right Round
1386.desc:
Replace a summoner spell with Heroic Swing (5.88 seconds after applying the 70 summoner spell haste from the global ARAM champion buff, starts post-effect).

Heroic Swing - Active: You can activate Heroic Swing three times before the ability goes on cooldown, and you can use the third cast only after 0.5 seconds of the second cast. An attack or movement command may be inputted to use the second and third casts.

20px|link= First Cast: Fire a hook in the target direction that embeds in the first terrain hit for 2 seconds. Heroic Swing's second cast can be used while the hook is attached. If the hook fails to attach or you become immobilized, grounded, or polymorphed within the duration, Heroic Swing is cancelled and placed on full cooldown.

20px|link= Second Cast: Swing around the terrain in either a clockwise or counterclockwise direction based on the position of the cursor Dash will move clockwise if the player's cursor is anywhere to the left of their champion from their facing direction (or perspective), and counterclockwise if the cursor is anywhere to their champion's right., stopping upon colliding with an enemy champion or terrain.
